LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_FighterVeteran.label: battlefield veteran
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_FighterVeteran.description: Has seen enough battles to stay steady in any situation. Martial power and marksman power +15%; max grit +2; pain shock threshold +10%. Fighter only. Grants +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_FighterHundredBattles.desc: Gets stronger the longer the fight, one move after another. Grit gain ×1.5; fighter ability cooldowns ×0.8; melee hit chance ×1.05, shooting accuracy ×1.05. Fighter only. Grants +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_MonkBreath.label: harmonized breath
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_MonkBreath.description: Every breath cultivates ki. Martial power +10%; max ki +2; ki recovery ×1.5; meditation focus gain +10%. Monk only. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_MonkShadowless.label: shadowless step
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_MonkShadowless.description: Strikes too fast to see, dodges too fast to see. Martial power +20%; melee dodge +12; move speed +0.4; monk ability cooldowns ×0.85. Monk only. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_PaladinOathkeeper.label: steadfast oath
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_PaladinOathkeeper.descript: The oath is carved into the heart; no temptation can shake it. Divine power +15%; mind resistance +20%; max divinity +1. Paladin only. Grants +1 Strength or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_PaladinZealot.label: holy flame zealot
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_PaladinZealot.description: Every blow carries the wrath of god. Melee damage ×1.08; paladin ability cooldowns ×0.8; divinity gain ×1.25. Paladin only. Grants +1 Strength or Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WizardScholar.label: arcane scholar
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WizardScholar.description: Turns the pages of the spellbook more diligently than anyone. Arcane power +15%; max mana +3; research speed ×1.1. Wizard only. Grants +1 Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WizardSculptor.label: spell sculpting
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WizardSculptor.description: Trims a spell's structure down to its leanest. Wizard ability mana cost -1 (minimum 1); wizard ability cooldowns ×0.85. Wizard only. Grants +1 Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_ClericDevout.label: devout supplicant
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_ClericDevout.description: The gods always answer when you pray. Divinity gain ×1.5; divine power +10%; tend quality ×1.1. Cleric only. Grants +1 Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_ClericBlessedHands.label: blessed hands
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_ClericBlessedHands.descrip: Divine power flows more smoothly through your hands. Max divinity +2; cleric ability cooldowns ×0.8; immunity gain speed ×1.15. Cleric only. Grants +1 Wisdom or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_DruidWildChild.label: child of the wild
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_DruidWildChild.description: Raised in the woods; every plant, bird and beast knows you. Primal power and verdant power +15%; plant work speed ×1.15; tame chance ×1.15. Druid only. Grants +1 Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_DruidWarden.label: nature's warden
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_DruidWarden.description: The power of nature protects those who protect it. Max mana +3; druid ability cooldowns ×0.85; toxic resistance +30%. Druid only. Grants +1 Wisdom or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_SorcererWellspring.label: wellspring of magic
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_SorcererWellspring.descrip: Magic wells up from your blood without end. Innate power +10%; mana gain ×1.5; max mana +3. Sorcerer only. Grants +1 Charisma or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_SorcererResonance.label: bloodline resonance
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_SorcererResonance.descript: The power of your bloodline is one with your will. Innate power +25%; psychic sensitivity +10%; sorcerer ability cooldowns ×0.9. Sorcerer only. Grants +1 Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BarbarianSmolder.label: burning fury
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BarbarianSmolder.descripti: Quick to ignite, and burns hotter the longer it goes. Rage power +10%; max rage +2; rage gain ×1.5. Barbarian only. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BarbarianFeralBody.label: wild physique
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BarbarianFeralBody.descrip: Charges back in before the wounds are even bandaged. Rage power +20%; wound healing ×1.3; pain shock threshold +10%. Barbarian only. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RangerWildHunter.label: wilderness hunter
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RangerWildHunter.descripti: Reads every footprint. Hunter power +15%; shooting accuracy ×1.05; ranger ability cooldowns ×0.9. Ranger only. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RangerStalker.label: master tracker
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RangerStalker.description: Prey you mark never gets away. Ranger ability cooldowns ×0.8; move speed +0.3; aiming time ×0.9. Ranger only. Grants +1 Dexterity or Wisdom.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RogueShadowVeteran.label: shadow veteran
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RogueShadowVeteran.descrip: Spent so long in dark alleys that you see every knife coming. Cunning power +15%; melee dodge +10. Rogue only. Grants +1 Dexterity or Intelligence.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RogueDeadlyPrecision.label: deadly precision
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_RogueDeadlyPrecision.descr: One cut, and every cut draws blood. Rogue ability cooldowns ×0.8; melee hit chance ×1.08; shooting accuracy ×1.05. Rogue only. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WarlockDeepPact.label: deepened pact
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WarlockDeepPact.descriptio: Signed one more line of the pact. Pact power +15%; max pact mana +1; warlock ability cooldowns ×0.9. Warlock only. Grants +1 Charisma.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WarlockPatronFavor.label: patron's favor
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_WarlockPatronFavor.descrip: Your patron's gaze never leaves you. Pact power +10%; warlock ability cooldowns ×0.8; mind resistance +25%. Warlock only. Grants +1 Charisma or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BardVoice.label: born singer
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BardVoice.description: A voice that naturally grips the heart. Inspiration power +10%; cadence gain ×1.5; max cadence +3; social impact +10%. Bard only. Grants +1 Charisma or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BardRenown.label: widely renowned
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Class_BardRenown.description: Your name is sung across the continent. Inspiration power +25%; bard ability cooldowns ×0.9; +2 goodwill with every non-hostile faction each quarter (not above +50). Bard only. Grants +1 Charisma.
